methodology.code_identity: For every row, HIP, HipGraph, and Redline load exactly the same hipcc code object selected by the recorded wave and scheduler policies. Vulkan runs matched GLSL algorithms compiled for RADV.
methodology.correctness: Every timed sequence is reset before timing and checked against a CPU oracle after its final sample. Only four-way correctness-passing rows are ranked.
methodology.redline_dependency: Required RMW edges use CS_PARTIAL_FLUSH plus vector/L1 invalidation for Radiowave-certified VMEM consumers. Scalar or unknown consumers fail closed to scalar/vector/L1 invalidation. Every Redline sample completes its HIP-to-PM4 system ownership acquire before the timed retained tape. Independent single-stage and aggressive single-kernel tapes contain no dependency fence.

timers.hipgraph: HIP device events around graph replay

timing_modes.independent_throughput: Disjoint output slices with no inter-operation dependency; HIP and Vulkan use up to four queues/streams while Redline uses one retained IB. Single-stage Redline rows omit dependency fences from the timed IB.
timing_modes.serial_latency: One true output RMW chain. Every operation is separated by the backend's required compute-write to compute-read/write dependency. Redline reuses immutable kernargs when every operation has identical arguments.
timing_modes.single_kernel_aggressive: Exactly one dispatch and one output operation. Redline's timed retained IB contains no entry acquire or dependency fence; the HIP-to-PM4 ownership acquire is replayed and waited outside the GPU timestamp window. Two-stage rows are excluded.

methodology.vulkan_memory: Device-local buffers with staging transfers outside the timing window.

wave_policy.all_wave32: Every HIP-family row selects the wave32 code object.
wave_policy.blanket_wave64: Every kernel family with any prior Vulkan-over-Redline row selects wave64.
wave_policy.radiowave_tuned: The targeted kernels, interleave, and every VOPD variant select wave64; dispatch_tiny uses one 32-lane workgroup because only lane zero is live; interleave selects buffer output for independent throughput and B128 loads with a one-wave HIP workgroup for aggressive latency while Vulkan retains its native shader geometry.
wave_policy.targeted_wave64: Only q4_selected_dual, q6_x8, dense_q8, and vopd_dependent select wave64.
